title: Great for no mess, no candle flame melts!
text: Great for no mess, no candle flame melts!. What a great little gadget! I love warmers and melts, but have always used the candle/tea light method burners. This plug looks great and works beautifully. It perfectly holds one cube of wax and gives a great little light. I love the easy on/off switch. Its super easy to clean and comes nicely packaged, ready to gift.

product_metadata.title: CANDLE WARMERS ETC. Pluggable Fragrance Warmer, Live, Laugh, Love
features: Enjoy this pluggable warmer with the heartwarming phrase "live, laugh, love"
Plugs directly into the wall; rotate base to fit any outlet and add scented wax melts to the warming dish to safely release fragrance throughout the home
Decorative electric fragrance warmer is ideal for smaller spaces and designed to warm scented wax, creating the glow and ambience of a burning candle
No soot, no smoke, no flame
description: Pluggable Fragrance Warmers can be used with any outlet in both a vertical and horizontal position, making it ideal for above-counter outlets in small rooms and spaces. They create the glow and ambience of a burning candle while releasing long-lasting fragrance. The warming bulb is included.
